blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Contrastive vision-language pre-training supports zero-shot chest X-ray diagnosis, but standard objectives treat every off-diagonal image-report pair in a batch as a negative. In radiology, recurring findings across patients mean that instance mismatch need not imply semantic incompatibility, creating false-negative supervision that we term a semantic conflict. A training-trace audit shows that pair-observations selected by the online mask used during training are enriched for report-derived finding agreement, although this proxy analysis does not establish clinical equivalence. Fixed thresholds can become miscalibrated as similarity distributions evolve, while soft reweighting leaves residual repulsive gradients. We therefore propose Semantic-Conflict-Aware Contrastive Learning (SCCL), which tracks modality-specific similarity distributions with exponential-moving-average (EMA) statistics, derives adaptive thresholds, and hard-masks flagged candidates before softmax normalization. Inclusive (OR) and consensus (AND) rules define two SCCL teachers, whose bidirectional cross-modal rankings are consolidated through standard distillation into a single deployable student, SCCL-DT. Across five public chest X-ray benchmarks, SCCL-DT achieves a mean zero-shot AUC of $0.850$, compared with $0.837$ for the strongest evaluated baseline in our comparison. Code will be made publicly available soon.
blocks.zh: 相矛盾的视觉-语言预训支持零发胸X射线诊断,但标准目标将分批分批的每对外相图像-报告配对视为负数. 在放射学中,患者间反复出现的结果意味着病例的不匹配并不一定意味着语义不相容,从而造成假阴性监督,我们称之为语义冲突. 一项培训跟踪审计显示,培训期间使用的在线口罩所选取的对等观测结果被丰富成报告生成的查找协议,尽管这一代理分析并不确立临床等同性. 固定阈值会随着相似性分布的演化而变得有误判性,而柔性再加权则会留下残余的反冲梯度. 因此,我们提出语义-冲突-意识相冲突学习(SCCL),该学习将跟踪特定模式的相似性分布和指数-指数-平均(EMA)统计数据,得出适应性阈值,硬面团标出候选人后再进行软面正常化。 包容性(OR)和共识(AND)规则定义了两位SCCL教师,他们的双向跨模式排名通过标准分解被整合为单一可部署学生SCCL-DT. 在5个公共胸口X光基准中,SCL-DT的中度零射出AUC为0.850美元,而相比之下,最强的评价基线为0.837美元。 守则将很快公布。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Vision–language pre-training (VLP) has emerged as a promising paradigm for zero-shot chest X-ray diagnosis. By aligning radiographs with their free-text reports, VLP models learn joint representations that can be queried with disease prompts at inference without requiring task-specific annotations [ 37 , 12 , 27 ] . Most medical VLP approaches optimize a batch-wise contrastive objective [ 23 , 25 ] : within a mini-batch of B B image–report pairs, matched pairs are treated as positives, whereas all off-diagonal pairs are treated as negatives. This formulation inherits a key assumption from instance-level contrastive learning: every unmatched pair is a valid negative.
blocks.zh: 视觉-语言预训(VLP)已成为零射胸X射线诊断的有希望范例. 通过将无线电图与其自由文本报告保持一致,甚高频频谱模型学习了可与疾病提示进行推论的共同表述,而不需要具体任务说明[37、12、27]。 大多数医用VLP方法优化了批量对比性目标[23,25]:在B图像-报告配对的小型批量内,配对配对被视为阳性配对,而所有非对角配对则被视为阴性配对. 此配方继承了实例级对比性学习的关键假设:每对未匹配的配对都是有效的负数.

blocks.en: This assumption is particularly fragile in radiology, where reports from different patients frequently describe overlapping findings using similar or interchangeable expressions. As illustrated in Figure 1 (a), the two batch items underlying an unmatched image–report candidate may share the same report-derived finding set. At a mini-batch size of 256 256 , an exact corpus-level calculation under uniform random batching estimates that 66.8 % 66.8\% of pathology-positive anchors would encounter at least one cross-patient batch mate with an identical CheXpert present-label set, with 2.78 2.78 such matches per anchor on average (Figure 1 (b)). A related enrichment appears in the recorded online masking decisions. Within the trace prefix ending at the best checkpoint, the inclusive rule used in the trace—which masks an off-diagonal pair when either the corresponding image–image or report–report similarity exceeds its modality-specific adaptive threshold—flags pair-observations with 3.96 % 3.96\% exact present-label-set agreement, compared with 1.83 % 1.83\% across all eligible pair-observations. Here, eligibility requires different patients and at least one positive label among the 12 pathology findings in each report; exact agreement is then evaluated over all 14 labels. The resulting 2.16 × 2.16\times enrichment remains above one throughout five consecutive training windows (Figure 1 (c)). Although exact CheXpert present-label-set agreement does not establish clinical equivalence, its enrichment among flagged pair-observations suggests that this subset may contain a higher proportion of semantically compatible pairs. Consequently, semantically compatible pairs may still receive negative contrastive targets, giving rise to false-negative supervision. Such false negatives are known to degrade generic contrastive learning [ 7 , 5 ] . We refer to this mismatch between semantic compatibility and the assigned contrastive target as a semantic conflict .
blocks.zh: 这种假设在放射学中特别脆弱,不同患者的报告经常用相似或可互换的表达来描述重叠的发现. 如图1(a)所示,无法匹配的图像-报告候选人的两个批次项目可能共享同一报告生成的一套调查结果。 在256 256的小型批量中,根据统一随机批量下精确的体积计算估计,66.8%的病理阳性锚将遇到至少一个具有相同切克斯珀特现标签的跨病人批量配对,平均每个锚有2.78 2.78个这种匹配(图1(b))。 在线掩盖决定中出现了相关的内容丰富。 在最佳检查点结束的跟踪前缀中,跟踪中使用的包容性规则——当相应的图像-图像或报告-报告相似性超过其特定模式的适应阈值时,该规则掩盖了对线外对面的对面——旗子对面观测,3.96 % 3.96 % 准确的现标签设定协议,而在所有合格的对面观测中,该比例为1.83%。 在此,资格要求不同的患者,并在每份报告的12个病理结论中至少有一个阳性标签;然后对所有14个标签进行准确的一致评价。 由此产生的2.16×2.16\频率在连续五个培训窗口中保持在一个以上(图1(c))。 虽然精确的CheXpert现标签集协议并未确立临床等效,但其在标注对等观测中的浓缩表明,该子集可能包含较高比例的相容对. 因此,成像兼容的对子仍然可能会受到负面的对比目标,从而引起虚假的负面监督。 这种假阴性已知可降解通用对比性学习[7,5]. 我们把语义兼容性与指定对比目标之间的这种不匹配称为语义冲突。

blocks.en: Prior work has attempted to mitigate false negatives by incorporating external clinical knowledge [ 30 , 19 ] , mining additional positive pairs from report- or study-level semantics [ 20 , 21 , 33 ] , or softly reweighting suspected false negatives during optimization [ 18 , 15 ] . Despite their effectiveness, two gaps remain. Detection: rules based on single-modality evidence or fixed, globally normalized similarity thresholds can become miscalibrated as modality-specific similarity distributions shift during representation learning. Optimization: additional positive mining may promote partial semantic compatibility to full equivalence, whereas soft reweighting still allows suspected false negatives to exert residual repulsive gradients unless their weights become exactly zero. An effective solution must therefore identify semantic conflicts adaptively and prevent them from being pushed apart without indiscriminately relabeling them as positives.
blocks.zh: 先前的工作试图通过纳入外部临床知识[30,19],从报告或研究层面的语义中挖掘更多的正对子[20,21,33],或在优化过程中对疑似假阴性进行软重评价[18,15]来缓解假阴性. 尽管它们很有效,但仍有两个差距。 检测:基于单模式证据或固定的,全球常态的相似阈值的规则,随着代表学习过程中特定模式的相似度分布的转变,可能会变得不适. 优化:额外的正矿开采可能会促进部分语义与完全等效的兼容性,而软重压仍然允许疑似假负方施加残余的反推梯度,除非它们的权重完全变为零. 因此,有效的解决办法必须适应性地确定语义冲突,防止它们被推开而不不加区别地重新标注为积极因素。

blocks.en: To address both gaps, we propose Semantic-Conflict-Aware Contrastive Learning (SCCL) , which dynamically flags potential semantic-conflict candidates using evidence from both modalities and removes them through adaptive hard masking. For detection, SCCL maintains separate exponential-moving-average (EMA) statistics for intra-batch image–image and report–report similarities, allowing each threshold to track its modality-specific distribution as training evolves. Flagged candidates are excluded from contrastive normalization, eliminating their probability mass and repulsive gradients rather than treating them as additional positives. To account for uncertainty in the modality-specific intra-modal cues, we instantiate two rule-specific teachers: an inclusive (OR) teacher that accepts evidence from either modality to increase candidate coverage, and a consensus (AND) teacher that requires agreement between both modality-specific cues for more conservative selection. Standard distillation then consolidates the two teachers’ cross-modal rankings into the single deployable student SCCL-DT. SCCL thus adapts candidate selection to evolving similarity distributions while explicitly preventing flagged candidates from being optimized as negatives.
blocks.zh: 为了填补这两个空白,我们提议采用语义-冲突-意识对抗学习(SCCL),用两种模式的证据,动态地标出潜在的语义冲突候选人,并通过适应性硬面罩将其删除。 为了侦测,SCCL对批内图像-图像和报告-报告相似性保持了单独的指数移动-平均(EMA)统计,使每个阈值能够随着培训的发展跟踪其模式的分布情况。 被标榜的考生被排除在对比性正常化之外,消除了他们的概率质量和反感梯度,而不是将其视为额外的阳性. 为了说明模式特定模式内提示的不确定性,我们即刻通知两位具体规则的老师:一位包容性的(OR)老师,接受两种模式中任何一种模式提供的证据来增加候选人的覆盖范围;一位共识的(AND)老师,要求两种模式特定提示之间达成一致,以便进行更保守的选择。 标准蒸馏然后将两位教师的跨模式排名整合为单一可部署学生SCL-DT. 因此,SCCL使候选人甄选适应不断变化的相似性分布,同时明确防止标注候选人被优化为负数。

blocks.en: Our contributions are: • We propose SCCL , a contrastive framework that adaptively hard-masks similarity-flagged off-diagonal candidates using per-modality EMA thresholds, without adding trainable parameters to the masking module. • We instantiate SCCL with inclusive and consensus rule-specific teachers and use standard distillation to consolidate their cross-modal rankings into SCCL-DT, a single deployable student. • On five public chest X-ray benchmarks (Open-I, PadChest, ChestX-ray14, CheXpert, and ChestXDet10), SCCL-DT reaches a mean zero-shot AUC of 0.850 0.850 , the highest among the compared methods, at single-model inference cost.
blocks.zh: • 我们的贡献是: 我们提议采用SCCL这一对比性框架,即采用每个模式的EMA阈值,适应性地使用硬块相似的外对面标记,而不在掩模中添加可训练参数。 我们利用包容性和共识性的具体规则教师对SCCL进行即时分析,并采用标准提炼,将其跨模式排名整合为SCCL-DT,一个单一可部署学生。 在5个公共胸X射线基准(Open-I, PadChest, ChestX-ray14,CheXpert,和 ChestXDet10)上,SCL-DT达到了0.850 0.850 0.850的中零射线AUC,在比较方法中最高,以单型推论成本计算.

blocks.en: 2.1 Medical vision–language pre-training
blocks.zh: 2.1 医疗视觉-语言预培训

blocks.en: Contrastive alignment of chest radiographs with their reports has driven rapid progress in label-efficient and zero-shot diagnosis. ConVIRT [ 37 ] adapts image–text contrastive learning to radiology, while MedCLIP [ 30 ] decouples images and texts to exploit unpaired data. GLoRIA [ 12 ] and MGCA [ 28 ] introduce local, multi-granularity alignment between image regions and report tokens; BioViL [ 2 ] strengthens the text encoder through domain-specific language modeling; and CheXzero [ 27 ] demonstrates expert-level zero-shot detection. KAD [ 35 ] incorporates a medical knowledge graph, and MRM [ 38 ] combines masked image and record modeling. More recent approaches replace global dot-product similarity with fine-grained cross-attention between image regions and report tokens. CARZero [ 16 ] scores pairs through cross-attention between one modality’s tokens and the other’s query, while RadZero [ 24 ] extends this paradigm toward region-level, explainable alignment. Beyond these advances in broader data utilization, stronger encoders, knowledge integration, or finer-grained alignment, SCCL addresses a distinct source of supervision error: treating semantically compatible off-diagonal pairs as negatives.
blocks.zh: 胸腔放射图与其报告不一致,推动了标签高效和零射诊断的快速进展。 ConVIRT [37] 将图像–文本对比性学习适应放射学,而MedCLIP [30] 拆解图像和文本,以利用未保存的数据. GLORIA [12] 和 MGCA [28] 引入了图像区域与报告符之间的局部,多引力对齐; BioViL [2] 通过特定域的语言建模加强文本编码器; Chexzero [27] 演示了专家级的零镜头检测. KAD [35] 包含一个医学知识图,MRM [38] 结合了蒙面图像和记录模型. 较新的办法取代全球点产品相似性,在图像区域与报告符号之间有细微的交叉注意。 CARZERO [16] 通过一种模式的符号与另一种模式的查询之间的交叉注意来评分对等,而RadZero [24] 将这一范式扩展到地区一级,可以解释的对齐。 除了在更广泛的数据利用、更强的编码器、知识集成或精细的配对方面的这些进展之外,SCCL还解决了监督错误的一个明显来源:将相容的离对子作为负数处理。

blocks.en: 2.2 False negatives in contrastive learning
blocks.zh: 2.2 国家 对比性学习中的假负数

blocks.en: Instance-discrimination objectives treat unmatched samples as negatives, so semantically compatible pairs may receive repulsive gradients [ 32 , 10 , 4 , 23 ] . Unlike valid hard negatives, false negatives should not be repelled. Prior work addresses this issue through distribution correction, hard-negative mining, progressive false-negative removal, or hardness scheduling [ 7 , 26 , 5 , 15 ] .
blocks.zh: 实例歧视目标将未匹配的样本视为负数,因此相容的对子可能得到反感梯度[32、10、4、23]。 与有效的硬底片不同,虚假底片不应被击退. 先前的工作通过分销纠正、硬阴性开采、渐进的假阴性清除或硬性排期[7、26、5、15]来解决这一问题。

blocks.en: Medical VLP methods instead exploit clinical knowledge or report semantics. MedCLIP and MLIP construct knowledge-guided targets [ 30 , 19 ] ; SAT, SENSE, and FaNe use report- or study-level similarity to mine or reweight pairs [ 20 , 21 , 33 ] ; and SAHN separates hard from false negatives using embedding and semantic similarity [ 18 ] . SCCL differs by applying modality-specific adaptive thresholds, hard-masking selected pairs without relabeling them, and distilling its rule-specific teachers into one student.
blocks.zh: 医学VLP方法则利用临床知识或报告语义学. MeDCLIP和MLIP构建了知识引导目标[30,19];SAT,SENSE,和FANE使用报告-或研究层面的相似度与我的或重磅对[20,21,33];SAHN使用嵌入和语义相似性将假底片与假底片严格分离[18]. SCCL通过应用特定模式的适应阈值,硬面的选定对子而不给它们重新贴上标签,以及将其特定规则的教师分馏成一个学生而有所不同.

blocks.en: 2.3 Knowledge distillation
blocks.zh: 2.3 知识蒸馏

blocks.en: Knowledge distillation transfers predictive distributions from a teacher to a student, commonly to compress a model or retain teacher behavior in a more deployment-efficient network [ 11 ] . Deep mutual learning extends this idea to online peer supervision [ 36 ] , while ALBEF uses a momentum teacher to provide stable targets for noisy image–text alignment [ 17 ] . These formulations differ in teacher construction but use distillation to transfer or stabilize predictive behavior. In SCCL, standard distillation consolidates two rule-specific teachers—an inclusive teacher and a consensus teacher—into a single student for efficient inference.
blocks.zh: 知识蒸馏将预测分布从教师转移到学生身上,通常用于压缩模型或保留教师在部署效率更高的网络中的行为[11]. 深层次的相互学习将这个想法延伸至在线同行监督[36],而ALBEF则使用动力老师为吵闹的图像-文本对齐[17]提供稳定的目标. 这些配体在教师构造上有所不同,但使用蒸馏来转移或稳定预测行为. 在SCCL中,标准蒸馏法将两个针对规则的教师——一个包容的教师和一个协商一致的教师——整合到一个学生身上,以便有效推论.

blocks.en: 4.1 Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 设置

blocks.en: Our implementation builds on CARZero [ 16 ] , which serves as the unmasked Base model. We pre-train on frontal AP/PA MIMIC-CXR images with usable reports [ 14 ] . Available report fields are concatenated and truncated or padded to 97 97 tokens. Images are resized and zero-padded to 256 × 256 256{\times}256 , cropped to 224 × 224 224{\times}224 , and augmented with random horizontal flips, affine transformations, and brightness/contrast jitter. Each run uses a ViT-B/16 image encoder initialized from M3AE [ 9 , 6 ] and a BioClinical BERT text encoder [ 1 ] . Teachers use k = 2.0 k{=}2.0 , m = 0.99 m{=}0.99 , and T w = 500 T_{w}{=}500 , and are optimized with Adam (learning rate 5 × 10 − 5 5{\times}10^{-5} , weight decay 10 − 6 10^{-6} ). We halve the learning rate after five validation epochs without improvement, early-stop after ten, and select the lowest-loss checkpoint. The student is trained for six epochs with Adam at 10 − 5 10^{-5} , using the same weight decay and scheduler and τ d = 2.0 \tau_{d}{=}2.0 . All training runs are conducted on NVIDIA A800 GPUs. The masking operator itself maintains only four scalar EMA states and adds no trainable weights. The complete two-stage protocol nevertheless trains two rule-specific teachers and one student under supervision from the two frozen teachers; only the student is retained for inference.

blocks.en: We evaluate on five public chest X-ray datasets without any fine-tuning: Open-I [ 8 ] , PadChest [ 3 ] (manually annotated subset), ChestX-ray14 [ 29 ] , CheXpert [ 13 ] , and ChestXDet10 [ 22 ] . For multi-label zero-shot classification, AUC is the primary metric; the PadChest ablations additionally report MCC, F1, and accuracy (ACC). For zero-shot grounding on ChestXDet10, we report the unweighted mean Pointing Game accuracy across ten findings. The 14 × 14 14{\times}14 cross-attention map is expanded to 224 × 224 224{\times}224 by patch-wise replication, and a trial is counted as a hit when a maximum-attention region overlaps an annotated lesion. Each map is independently min–max normalized for visualization.

blocks.en: Across the recorded training trace, the actual OR mask enriches report-derived exact label agreement from 1.83 % 1.83\% among eligible pairs to 3.96 % 3.96\% among flagged pairs ( 2.16 × 2.16\times ). Descriptively, the lift is above one in each of five epoch windows and is also observed for Image-only candidates; the same qualitative pattern is observed under partial-overlap measures and an alternative labeler. These analyses evaluate whether the online mask preferentially selects label-overlapping pairs; they do not measure the recall of clinically adjudicated false negatives. Full definitions, counts, and sensitivity analyses are provided in the supplementary material.
blocks.zh: 在整个记录的培训跟踪中,实际的OR面罩丰富了报告衍生的准确标签协议,从合格对子的1.83%1.83%增加到标定对子的3.96%3.96%(2.16×2.16\时)。 说明性地说,升降机在五个世纪窗口中每个窗口都高于一个,而且只观测到图像候选人的升降机;在部分重叠措施和替代标签下观察到同样的质量模式。 这些分析评价在线面罩是否优先选择了标签重叠的对;它们不衡量临床判断的假底片的召回. 补充材料中提供了完整的定义、计数和敏感性分析。

blocks.en: Table 1 compares SCCL-DT with published zero-shot chest X-ray classification methods across five benchmarks. The final distilled student achieves the highest mean AUC of 0.850 0.850 , exceeding RadZero ( 0.837 0.837 ) and CARZero ( 0.836 0.836 ) by 0.013 0.013 and 0.014 0.014 , respectively. Under this unified classification evaluation protocol, SCCL-DT achieves the highest AUC on Open-I, ChestX-ray14, and ChestXDet10, while ranking second on PadChest and CheXpert; on CheXpert, it trails the best result by only 0.001 0.001 . The consistent performance across these heterogeneous datasets provides evidence of cross-dataset robustness, while inference retains a single model.

Relative to RadZero, SCCL-DT performs better on all datasets except PadChest and improves the mean AUC by 0.013 0.013 . Accordingly, Table 1 provides a same-test-set, public-checkpoint classification comparison under a common dataset and label scope. blocks.en: 4.3 Ablation and Diagnostic Studies
blocks.zh: 4.3 发育和诊断研究

blocks.en: We report controlled PadChest studies under a unified evaluation protocol across AUC, MCC, F1, and accuracy (ACC). The OR/AND/KD, threshold, and similarity-cue studies characterize prespecified SCCL configurations. Two-tier, count-matched Random, and Soft weighting instead serve as diagnostic controls rather than SCCL components: they examine whether a single compromise rule can replace the separate inclusive and consensus teachers, whether gains depend on structured candidate selection beyond mask quantity alone, and whether hard exclusion is preferable to soft attenuation, respectively. These results are not used for hyperparameter tuning or default-configuration selection. The five-dataset mean AUC provides a cross-dataset consistency check. We retain ACC as a critical classification metric; because it remains near 0.991 0.991 across configurations, most between-configuration differences appear in AUC, MCC, and F1. Unless otherwise specified, the controlled studies use a prespecified default comprising an adaptive threshold with k = 2 k{=}2 , the inclusive rule, hard masking, and both similarity cues; Table 3 separately compares the two rule-specific teachers and the single- and dual-teacher students.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: Standard contrastive pre-training treats all off-diagonal image–report pairs as negatives, which can introduce semantic conflicts when reports share findings. We proposed Semantic-Conflict-Aware Contrastive Learning (SCCL) , which uses modality-specific adaptive thresholds to identify candidate conflicts and removes them from contrastive normalization without relabeling them as positives. Distillation consolidates the resulting rule-specific supervision into a single deployable model. The online mask is enriched for report-derived finding agreement, providing proxy evidence for the selection mechanism rather than pair-level clinical adjudication. Across five public benchmarks, SCCL-DT achieves the highest mean zero-shot AUC among the evaluated methods ( 0.850 0.850 vs. 0.837 0.837 ) and the highest mean ChestXDet10 Pointing Game accuracy ( 0.583 0.583 ). Together, these results support adaptive conflict removal as an effective alternative to indiscriminate negative supervision under the evaluated settings.
blocks.zh: 标准对比性预训将所有非对角图像 — 报告对子视为负数,这可以在报告共享结果时引入语义冲突. 我们提出了语义-冲突-认知矛盾学习(SCCL),它使用特定模式的适应性阈值来识别候选冲突,并将它们从对比性正常化中去除,而不将它们重新贴上正面标签. 蒸馏将由此产生的针对具体规则的监督合并为一个单一的可部署模式。 在线口罩为报告生成的寻找协议而丰富,为选择机制提供代理证据,而不是对等的临床判断. 在五个公共基准中,SCL-DT在被评价方法中实现了最高的中间零射AUC(0.850 0.850对0.837 0.837),最高的中间胸XDet10 指向游戏精度(0.583 0.583). 这些结果共同支持了因地制宜地消除冲突,作为在所评价环境中不加区别地进行负面监督的有效替代办法。

blocks.en: Future work should clinically adjudicate candidate pairs, study calibration across batch sizes and domains, and extend adaptive detection to local region–token alignment and other medical imaging modalities.
blocks.zh: 未来的工作应该以临床方式判定候选配对,研究分批量大小和领域的校准,并将适应性检测推广到局部地区 — — 吻合和其他医疗成像模式。

blocks.en:
We evaluate zero-shot grounding on the ChestXDet10 test set using the Pointing

reported in the main paper.

This section precisely defines the Two-tier, count-matched Random, and Soft
weighting controls used to interpret the main results. They are explanatory
comparisons rather than removable components of SCCL: Two-tier examines a

controls for mask quantity, and Soft weighting contrasts attenuation with hard

contrastive cross-entropy during stage-one pre-training; none changes an
encoder, the fusion module, or the inference path. The definitions follow the
active MLP stage-one implementation and the configuration used by each run.
